summary: Full audit & correction platform tested end-to-end. All 10 backend pytest cases PASS (auth gating, audit report, user lookup case-insensitive + 404, recompute dry-run, balance immutability). Frontend admin flow verified via Playwright: login -> dashboard -> 'admin-open-audit' button -> /audit page with 3 tabs (overview/recompute/user) all working. Overview shows 'Aucune anomalie' (preview is clean: 0 issues, 8 users, 7 placements, 4 commissions). Recompute tab shows warning + 3 option chips + dry-run button + apply button (post dry-run). User tab lookup of 'admin' renders card with username/email/level/balances/direct_downline/descendants_per_level WITHOUT leaking password_hash. Invalid username search correctly hides the card.

issues: Frontend logs a 404 in browser console (expected backend behavior) but no visible inline error message uses class containing 'error' — relies only on card disappearance. Consider adding a visible error toast/banner with data-testid='audit-user-error' for better UX and easier testing.

action_items: Optional UX: add explicit visible error banner (with data-testid) on user tab when lookup returns 404 — currently only the card hides.
critical_code_review_comments: audit_admin.py is well-isolated, idempotent, and correctly excludes password_hash via projection (lines 255, 260) — verified no leak in UI body text.
Recompute endpoint correctly never touches balance_profit/balance_upgrade — verified with before/after read (admin: balance_profit=3000, balance_upgrade=1000 unchanged after dry_run=false).
Duplicate import of `datetime, timezone as _tz` at lines 348 and 464 in audit_admin.py — second import is dead code, can be removed.
_run_audit loads up to 100000 docs into memory (lines 63-66) — fine for current scale (8 users) but should switch to streaming/aggregation if user base grows >50k.
_restore_admin_placements_unused stub at end of file (line 482) is dead code, should be removed.
seed_data_creation: None — tests are read-only or idempotent (recompute applied with all fix flags off / clean preview).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Audit module is stable and idempotent. Preview DB is currently clean (0 anomalies). Tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_audit.py and validate: auth gating (401/403), GET /audit structure, GET /audit/user/{username} case-insensitive + 404 + password_hash absence, POST /recompute dry-run + no-op apply + balance immutability. JUnit at /app/test_reports/pytest/audit.xml. Frontend testIDs verified: admin-open-audit, audit-tab-{overview|recompute|user}, audit-no-issues, audit-recompute-warn, opt-clean-orphans, opt-trigger-upgrades, opt-restore-admin, audit-dry-run, audit-apply, audit-user-search, audit-user-search-btn, audit-user-card.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. The previously reported anomalies (admin total_earned 12000 vs commission sum 6000, 2 orphan placements, missing admin matrix roots L1/L2) were already corrected in this preview iteration by running recompute with restore_admin_placements=true. Re-running recompute is now a no-op (counter_updates=0, orphan_placements_deleted=0, upgrades_triggered=0, admin_placements_restored=0). balance_profit=3000 and balance_upgrade=1000 for admin remain untouched, confirming the safety guarantee.
